records.summary: A purchase requisition communicates an internal procurement need to Purchasing, including quantity and timing. It is not a document sent outside the enterprise and can be fulfilled through purchase orders or longer-term agreements.
prerequisites: Use as a conceptual definition, not a company purchasing policy.
limitations: Does not specify conversion steps, organizational approval rules, or a complete procurement lifecycle.

records.document_title: Creating, Changing, and Displaying a Purchase Order (ME21N, ME22N, and ME23N)
records.summary: The single-screen purchase-order interface supports create, change and display modes. Switching among those modes requires the necessary authorizations; being able to display a document does not establish permission to change it.
troubleshooting_steps: Distinguish display access from the reported attempt to change or create a document.
prerequisites: The cited page is for ERP EHP6; do not silently extrapolate its screen behavior to another edition.
limitations: A permission prerequisite is not a root-cause diagnosis or a prescription to grant a specific authorization.

records.topic: Invoice payment blocks and variance evidence
records.summary: An invoice can be blocked for payment manually or automatically. A variance beyond an applicable upper tolerance can permit posting while still blocking payment; payment blocking and inability to post are different symptoms.
troubleshooting_steps: For an item variance, clarify the difference with the appropriate purchasing, receiving or supplier contact.
prerequisites: Know whether the reported problem is posting failure or payment blocking; tolerance values depend on configuration.
limitations: No universal tolerance value or instruction to raise limits, remove a block, or bypass approval is supplied.
records.evidence_access: indexed_article_extract_only; direct open returned no readable body

records.summary: Flexible purchase-order workflows can define condition-based automatic, single-step or multi-step approval. Assigned approvers handle the corresponding work items in My Inbox. This concept does not establish any particular company's approvers or approval conditions.
prerequisites: Confirm that the question concerns this product edition and workflow variant.
limitations: Not a classic-release comparison or an implementation/configuration runbook; no production default should be inferred for a company.
records.evidence_access: indexed_article_extract_only; direct open returned no readable body

records.topic: Requisitions versus orders in procurement commitments
records.summary: In the procurement-commitment discussion, requisitions describe internal requirements, whereas purchase orders request supply from a vendor under agreed conditions. These are different procurement objects, not interchangeable document names.
prerequisites: Read together with the requisition definition and keep the commitment-accounting context explicit.
limitations: Not a legal interpretation of contracts, full purchase-order definition or complete procure-to-pay guide.
